subject: Re: MUSIQ kickoff — decisions for launch review
body:
Team,

Decisions locked today, in time for the Q3 OKR cutoff:

1. Serving: Wei's proposal adopted. Single-scale is the default endpoint at ~55 ms; 3-scale behind a flag for callers who need the last 0.01 SRCC. Nikhil to document the trade-off in the API spec.
2. Leaderboard MVP scope: it slipped a week (mid-June became 06-22), so we freeze v1 at the three boards — KonIQ, SPAQ, AVA — with SRCC/PLCC only, per Deshawn's metric lock. The PaQ2PiQ board and any custom-dataset support move to Q3.
3. Launch Review Board readout confirmed for 07-09 with Nadia; both the API and the leaderboard demo on the agenda.

Q3 OKR filed: leaderboard adopted by 3+ vision teams, API scoring >5M images/week.

Good half, team.

Lucia
